query:
SELECT
          m.id,
          m.alias,
          m.is_catch_all,
          m.domain_id,

          (
            u.id,
            u.username,
            u.password_hash,
            u.created_at,
            u.updated_at
          ) AS "owner!: User",

          m.created_at,
          m.updated_at

        FROM mailboxes m
        INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = m.owner_id
        INNER JOIN domains d ON d.id = m.domain_id
        WHERE m.id = $1;
